retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast image featuring a hand in a sequined glove with horizontal motion blur and prismatic color fringing against a void-like black background.
excludeWhen: sharp focus on texture is needed
bright or colorful backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central hand wearing a white glove densely covered in iridescent rhinestones, making an 'OK' gesture. The image is defined by a heavy horizontal motion blur effect that creates 'trails' of light and color, specifically chromatic aberration (red and cyan fringing) on the edges of the glove against a pitch-black background.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the bright, reflective glove and the absolute black background
Horizontal motion blur extending from the right side of the glove's silhouette
Prismatic light refraction within the individual rhinestones
A beaded bracelet at the wrist providing a secondary point of detail

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The hand is centrally located, angled diagonally from the bottom left toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular negative space created by the 'OK' gesture (thumb and forefinger meeting).
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the arm upward to the glove, then is pulled horizontally to the right by the motion blur trails.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the subject, emphasizing the glow and glitch effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White/Silver (base of the glove and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Prismatic Cyan and Red (chromatic aberration and refraction)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the spectral highlights in the glitch trails.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast black ink on white beads
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are simplified to fit small circular constraints
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The beaded text acts as a tactile, low-fi contrast to the digital glitch of the glove.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, functional look of bead lettering
Mimics the soft edges of plastic beads

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a hand in a rhinestone-covered glove against a black background with heavy horizontal motion blur and chromatic aberration.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a beaded bracelet to the wrist with custom uppercase lettering on each bead following the curve of the arm.

verificationChecks: Does the motion blur only move horizontally?
Are there visible red/cyan fringes on the highlights?

mustRedesign: Any recognizable brand logos on the glove
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the glove looks encrusted, not just patterned
Confirm the background is noise-free black
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Hand in Rhinestone Glove] + Effect [Horizontal Motion Blur + Chromatic Aberration] + Environment [Black Void] = Glitch Luxury Aesthetic
